shared_prompt: Create one entirely original 16:9 card illustration for an original browser zoo strategy game. Contemporary cut-paper collage mixed with matte gouache, bold rounded geometric shapes, subtle paper grain, clean thumbnail-readable silhouettes, non-photographic. Keep important subjects inside the central 80 percent for safe cropping. Palette: forest green, muted coral, ochre, cream, teal, restrained charcoal. No source image and no reference, imitation, or reproduction of Ark Nova or any existing board-game art. No text, letters, numbers, logos, emblems, badges, card frame, UI, or watermark.
